description_zh: 一辆 Zoox 车辆在手动模式下右转时撞上交通岛，无其他道路使用者参与，属于单车撞固定物体，无交互方。
reason: 属于单车冲出路缘/失控（无第二参与者）或非碰撞事故，无测试价值的交互方。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle operating in manual mode was eastbound on Frederick Street and turning right onto Buena Vista Avenue in San Francisco when the front wheel on the driver's side struck a traffic island to the left side of the vehicle.
TYPE OF COLLISION: E. HIT OBJECT
